scenarios.expected: Changes apply to the intended account and revoked sessions cease granting access. Unauthorized administration, invalid invites, and self/last-Administrator safeguards behave as implemented.
scenarios.actual: 31 recorded browser steps passed for this article (25 on aoauth, 6 on aowiz). Nadia was sent from Settings General and Users to /settings/profile and the users and invite APIs answered 403; a Business User opening /settings, /settings/general and /settings/users landed in the Portal. Organization name saved on Enter, Escape restored the saved name, reload kept it. Upload refused a text file and a PNG over 5 MB with "Logo must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG image 5 MB or smaller. Pick another file." (the b656bfb6 wording) and an unreadable .png and a 4001 x 4001 PNG with "The logo must be a readable PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG with no more than 16 million pixels."; a PNG and an SVG saved; the pane had no remove control. The name and logo appeared on /auth/login and /portal/login without a session, in the staff app and Portal headers, and in the invitation email header (org-logo image); with no name the sign-in pages and a test email showed OpenLaw and the OpenLaw mark. Default timezone saved America/Toronto and was restored to Europe/London; Default locale offered only English (United States). Invite user offered Legal team member and Administrator; Send invite added an Invited row with Resend invite and Revoke invite and sent "Set your OpenLaw password" with a Set password button and a 1 hour expiry. An invalid address kept the dialog open; a same-role re-invite resent with one row; a different role gave "This user already exists with a different role."; Nadia and Jonas Weber gave "This user has already activated their account."; Resend invite showed Saved and a new link. A first sign-in by a sign-in link and a Set password sign-in each turned the row Active; Revoke invite removed a pending row. With no mailer, Send invite and Resend invite showed "The invite was not sent: this instance cannot send email." followed by "Set SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM together in the environment." (environment relay without SMTP_FROM) or "Set up outbound email in Settings → Advanced → Outbound email." (unset), and no row was added. The role control offered Administrator, Legal team member, Business user; Administrator applied on the colleague's next navigation and the demotion gave 403 on the next request; a Portal-created Business User promoted to Legal team member stayed Active with its role control. Daniel's own row had no Archive and no … button; self-archive answered "You cannot archive yourself."; on aowiz the only Administrator got "You cannot demote the last Administrator." and "You cannot archive the last Administrator.". The row's … button ("More actions for" the email) offered Sign out user; the session went from 200 to 401 and a new password sign-in worked. Archive hid the row, ended the session, refused sign-in with "This account has been archived.", sent no sign-in link, and left the archived colleague as Legal Owner of a fixture Contract. Show archived appeared only once an account was archived; Restore returned the row to Active, the old session stayed 401 and a new sign-in worked.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the source reviewer; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
The guide bytes did not change in DOC-032; the walk was repeated because the app changed since 067c1646 (logo refusal wording from b656bfb6 and refactors in the org routes).

The organization name, logo and timezone were changed and restored on the owned aoauth lab, not on the shared work lab. The logo (none) was restored through PATCH /api/v1/org/general because the pane has no remove control.

The promoted-Business-User Invited branch needs an account that has never signed in; every Portal-created Business User has, so the row stayed Active as the guide says. The Invited branch was not reproduced.
Upgrade-time copies of logos saved before email logos existed were not exercised; the labs were built fresh. JPEG and WebP uploads were not tried.
Reassignment was checked as the negative claim only (a Contract kept its archived Legal Owner). Reassigning records belongs to the linked guides.
